build_cmu_humanoid_run_walls: build a CMU humanoid environment that runs down a corridor obstructed by randomized walls
build_cmu_humanoid_run_gaps: build a CMU humanoid environment that runs down a corridor with randomized gaps and platforms
build_cmu_humanoid_go_to_target: build a CMU humanoid environment that navigates to a target on a standard floor arena
build_cmu_humanoid_maze_forage: build a CMU humanoid environment that finds all target items in a randomly generated maze
build_cmu_humanoid_heterogeneous_forage: build a CMU humanoid environment that collects correct targets while avoiding wrong ones in a fixed maze
